support_spans: Chest X-ray: Shows tumor in the center, pleural effusion on left side, and diffuse granular shadows on right side

support_spans: HE staining showed inflammatory cell infiltration and fibrosis around bronchioles

concepts.why: The biopsy findings of inflammatory cell infiltration and fibrosis around bronchioles, along with hypertrophy of elastic fibers, suggest a diagnosis of bronchiolitis obliterans.
